add-card.svelte.purpose: The single Add card button: the stock Dialog choosing a card kind, then that kind's editor.

avatar-editor.svelte.purpose: The owner's Shape button beside the name, opening the stock Dialog that saves the avatar's shape (round or rounded square).

card-controls.svelte.purpose: The owner's controls on each profile card, at its top right: edit, move up and down, delete behind a confirm.

card-editor.svelte.purpose: A profile card's editor: the stock Dialog holding one form for the page's create or save action, or the same form in place as a panel.

card-panel.svelte.purpose: The owner's editor in place on the stock Card when the page is opened with one (no script): edit, delete, add or the avatar's shape.

card-text.svelte.purpose: A Text card's words on the owner's page, edited where they stand once the page is idle (ADR 0074 item 4); the rendered blocks with no script.

text-menus.svelte.purpose: The in-place Text editor's side handle, block menu and floating bar, as Crepe draws them; editor/menus.ts places them with Milkdown's plugins (P1.21v slice 3).

carousel.svelte.purpose: A carousel card's sideways scrolling area, a keyboard stop, with the stock Button as Previous and Next once script runs.

choice.svelte.purpose: A labelled choice in a card editor: native radio inputs and the stock Label, so it works with no script.

field.svelte.purpose: A labelled text field in a card editor: the stock Label over the stock Input or Textarea.

profile-cards.svelte.purpose: The profile's cards in a two-column grid on the stock Card: Text, links, collection, buttons.

limited-profile.svelte.purpose: The limited page (ADR 0078): one card centered on the page with only avatar, name, handle and DID and one sentence, for someone the member's page visibility leaves out; a sign-in button when signing in would show the page.

own-public-view.svelte.purpose: The notice above the member's own public page when the member looks at it: how others see it, and a plain link back to the page they edit.

page-audience.svelte.purpose: The notice above a member page that is not public (ADR 0078): who else sees it.

profile-layout.svelte.purpose: The member page's frame: the profile header, then the notices, then one centred card area (ADR 0077).

profile-header.svelte.purpose: The profile header (ADR 0072, ADR 0077): avatar and name, and a native popover under the avatar with the profile's About panel (handle and details); not a shadcn component, since the public page runs no script.

readme-copy.svelte.purpose: The Text card's blocks (readme.svelte) with a stock Button in each code block's corner, once script runs, that copies its code as plain text (P1.21v).

readme.svelte.purpose: The Text card's parsed blocks (the #readme kind) as plain escaped elements, on the page's type scale.

table-tools.svelte.purpose: The editor's table tools: a handle above the column and beside the row under the pointer, each with a plain menu over Milkdown's own table commands, and the line that shows where a dragged row or column lands (P1.21v); not a shadcn component, since editor/tables.ts places and shows them inside the editor.

text-editor.svelte.purpose: The Text card's field: the stock Label and Textarea the form posts, with the Milkdown editor and a formatting bar of stock Buttons drawn over it once script has loaded it (P1.21u).

unsaved-bar.svelte.purpose: The owner's unsaved changes: one sticky bar above the name and avatar with the count, Save and Discard (ADR 0074 item 4).

drafts-offer.svelte.purpose: Unsaved words this device kept from an earlier visit, offered back on the owner's page or thrown away (ADR 0074 item 4).

settings-layout.svelte.purpose: The settings pages' frame: the side list of settings pages beside the page, a row above it on phones.

account-settings.svelte.purpose: Settings › Account's cards: handle and DID, the sign-in server link, and the two sign-out forms.

profile-form.svelte.purpose: Settings › Profile's form: name, headline, place and website, posted to /profile, inline refusal with script.

search-ai-fields.svelte.purpose: Settings › Privacy's Search and AI fields under Public (ADR 0062, ADR 0078): two switches, search title and description under a native Advanced disclosure, their honest limits and the search result preview; says when listing is off on the whole site (P1.21b).

privacy-form.svelte.purpose: Settings › Privacy's one form (ADR 0078): Public, Signed-in members only or Only me as native radios, the Search and AI fields under Public shown by CSS while it is ticked, the disclaimer always shown, each choice's line in a native popover; posted to /settings/search-and-ai; works with no script.

search-preview.svelte.purpose: Settings › Privacy's search result preview (P1.21y): the title, description and address the public page publishes, with the letter avatar until the media origin serves pictures; labelled as an example.

dismiss-all.svelte.purpose: The notifications' Dismiss all form: names the newest entry listed, posted to /notifications?/dismissAll, for the bell and the page (P2.27, ADR 0081).

inbox.svelte.purpose: The notifications page (P2.27b, ADR 0081): fills the window below the header; a list with checkboxes and Dismiss selected beside the chosen entry's detail, a split the member drags between 2/5 and 3/5, a cut-off row lifted above the detail on hover; plain forms and links with no script; the detail as its own screen on a phone.

notification-list.svelte.purpose: The bell's notifications as rows: each a plain link to its detail on /notifications, times in UTC until script shows the device's zone (P2.27, ADR 0081).

sign-in-history.svelte.purpose: The Sign-in history tab (P2.27c, ADR 0082): the member's sign-ins in the last 30 days, date and time and how long ago, in a list that scrolls under a header row that stays; a Delete form per row, Delete selected and Delete all; plain forms with no script.

tabs.svelte.purpose: The two tabs of /notifications (P2.27c): Notifications and Sign-in history, plain links, the current one aria-current=page.

account-menu.svelte.purpose: The header's account menu with script (book P1.22m, ADR 0116 points 8 and 9): the stock Dropdown Menu holding the member's two links, the theme choices as radio rows, and Sign out as a submit button of the shell's sign-out form. The shell draws the menu with no script itself and loads this file after the client starts.
